A_global.reference: Authored 2*blanket campaign full-power years divided by case calendar horizon; target schedule fraction, not measured availability.

I_p.reference: Authored verification setting for the two-cycle blanket-only lifecycle case; not plant data.

blk_1_dpa.reference: Authored verification threshold = 5.00736377025037 dpa/FPY × 2.53059542779396 FPY. The rate scales the 10.2 dpa/FPY, 2037 MW EU-DEMO example value linearly to 1000 MW fusion power; this does not establish FARIS fluence-to-DPA equivalence or physical validation.

blk_2_dpa.reference: Authored verification threshold = 5.00736377025037 dpa/FPY × 2.53059542779396 FPY. The rate scales the 10.2 dpa/FPY, 2037 MW EU-DEMO example value linearly to 1000 MW fusion power; this does not establish FARIS fluence-to-DPA equivalence or physical validation.

bmd.reference: Authored 60 calendar-day blanket maintenance duration from the archived FARIS fixed-history scenario.

div_dpa.reference: Authored high sentinel to keep divertor, vessel and TF limits outside this blanket-only verification scope; not a material limit.

dmd.reference: Authored verification setting for the two-cycle blanket-only lifecycle case; not plant data.

n_DD_reactions.reference: Authored zero DD reaction rate for this controlled verification config.

n_DT_reactions.reference: Authored verification reaction rate corresponding approximately to 1 GW fusion power divided by 17.6 MeV per D-T reaction; not measured and not an experimentally validated FARIS mapping.

s_ramp_down.reference: Authored very-high ramp rate to make ramp downtime negligible in this controlled fixed-pulse boundary; not a design or measured plant limit.

s_ramp_up.reference: Authored very-high ramp rate to make ramp downtime negligible in this controlled fixed-pulse boundary; not a design or measured plant limit.

t_pulse.reference: Authored verification setting for the two-cycle blanket-only lifecycle case; not plant data.

t_pumpdown.reference: Authored verification setting for the two-cycle blanket-only lifecycle case; not plant data.

tf_fluence.reference: Authored high sentinel to keep divertor, vessel and TF limits outside this blanket-only verification scope; not a material limit.
